title: Finite reductions of a derived-complete constructible complex
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning a scheme with a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring and $J\subseteq A$ an ideal. On the small pro-étale and étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site] use constant coefficient sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and derived scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let $N\in D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\underline A)$ be locally derived $J\underline A$-complete [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete]. Suppose $N\otimes_A^L\underline{A/J}\simeq
u_X^*C$, where $
u_X$ is [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $C$ is a bounded étale $A/J$-complex, and each $H^q(C)$ has a finite constructible locally closed stratification on which it is locally constant with finitely generated $A/J$-module values [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Suppose integers $a\leq b$ satisfy $H^q(C\otimes_{\underline{A/J}}^L F)=0$ for every degree-zero étale $A/J$-module sheaf $F$ and every $q
otin[a,b]$.

Put $N_n=N\otimes_A^L\underline{A/J^n}$, with the quotient transitions. Then $N\simeq R\varprojlim_nN_n$ [def-weil-derived-limit], $H^q(N)=0$ for $q
otin[a,b]$, and each $N_n$ has Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ on the pro-étale site. There are bounded étale $A/J^n$-complexes $C_n$ with constructible cohomology and Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$, isomorphisms $\alpha_n:
u_X^*C_n\simeq N_n$, and isomorphisms $ eta_n:C_{n+1}\otimes_{\underline{A/J^{n+1}}}^L\underline{A/J^n}\simeq C_n$. One may choose $C_1=C$ and the given residue isomorphism. The $ eta_n$ satisfy the quotient cocycle, and $\alpha_n
u_X^* eta_n=ho_n(\alpha_{n+1}\otimes^L\underline{A/J^n})$, where $ho_n$ is the canonical tensor-associativity normalization of the reduction tower. No quotient $A/J^n$ is assumed finite or perfect over $A$.

proof.text: Use Lean indices n >= 0, with exponent n+1; the statement's positive index is n+1. Apply [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-tor] to the given residue object and isomorphism, obtaining the Tor interval for every reduction without using completeness. Apply [lem-sfb-adic-finite-completion-bounds] to this family and the given completeness, obtaining the actual derived limit and cohomology interval.

Apply [lem-sfb-adic-finite-etale-origins] separately at every index. The families are typed by the normalized constructions of [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. Choose witnesses K_n, their constructibility and Tor proofs, and comparison isomorphisms. Define the dependent family C_n by C_0=C and C_(n+1)=K_(n+1); define alpha_0=e and alpha_(n+1) by the chosen isomorphism. Case analysis on n proves constructibility and the same Tor interval for this overwritten family. This dependent construction preserves the originally prescribed residue object and isomorphism literally.

Apply [lem-sfb-adic-finite-etale-transitions] to this chosen family and these alpha maps. It yields beta for all quotient maps, with the specified cocycle and compatibility. Package the limit, bounds, Tor tests and marked family. The zero-index equality is reflexivity and its comparison equation follows from preservation of the identity.

lean.statement:
theorem adic_constructible_finite_reductions (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (N : adicFiniteAmbient.{u, v} X A) (hcomplete : adicFiniteComplete.{u, v} X A J N)
    (C : adicFiniteEtale.{u, v} X J 0)
    (hC : IsCoefficientBoundedConstructibleEtale.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J 0) C)
    (e : (adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J 0)).obj C ≅
      adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N 0)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hTor : HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude
      (constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) (adicFiniteCoeff J 0)) C a b) :
    (∃ hp : HasProduct (adicFiniteUnderlying.{u, v} X J N),
      @IsDerivedLimit _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hp (adicFiniteTransition.{u, v} X J N) N) ∧
    (∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) → IsZero ((coefficientModelCohomology
      (constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A) q).obj N)) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, HasCoefficientProEtaleTorAmplitude.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J n)
      (adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N n) a b) ∧
    ∃ (Cn : ∀ n : ℕ, adicFiniteEtale.{u, v} X J n)
      (alpha : ∀ n : ℕ, (adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J n)).obj (Cn n) ≅
        adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N n)
      (beta : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
        (adicFiniteExtension (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
          (adicFiniteFactor J h)).obj (Cn m) ≅ Cn n),
      (∀ n : ℕ, IsCoefficientBoundedConstructibleEtale.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J n) (Cn n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude
        (constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) (adicFiniteCoeff J n))
          (Cn n) a b) ∧
      (∃ hzero : Cn 0 = C,
        (adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J 0)).map (eqToIso hzero).hom ≫ e.hom =
          (alpha 0).hom) ∧
      (∀ (r m n : ℕ) (hnm : n ≤ m) (hmr : m ≤ r),
        (adicFiniteExtensionComp (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
          (adicFiniteFactor J hmr) (adicFiniteFactor J hnm)
          (adicFiniteFactor J (hnm.trans hmr)) (adicFiniteFactorComp J hnm hmr)).hom.app
            (Cn r) ≫ (beta (hnm.trans hmr)).hom =
        (adicFiniteExtension (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
          (adicFiniteFactor J hnm)).map (beta hmr).hom ≫ (beta hnm).hom) ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
        (adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J n)).map (beta h).hom ≫ (alpha n).hom =
        (adicFiniteComparison.{u, v} X (adicFiniteFactor J h)).inv.app (Cn m) ≫
          (adicFiniteExtension (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
            (adicFiniteFactor J h)).map (alpha m).hom ≫ (adicFiniteRho.{u, v} X J N h).hom)
